feeds.title: Art Scene India Blog
feeds.description: An art blog on Indian and International modern and contemporary art events, news, reviews, interviews with artists, collecting art and more.

feeds.title: Eternal Expression Tattoo & Piercing Studio Blog
feeds.description: Voted India's Best Tattoo studio in Bangalore. At Eternal Expression Tattoo & Piercing Studio Bangalore, we create Body Art that`s Engineered for the mind, body & Soul.

feeds.title: Madhubani (Mithila) Paintings by Vidushini | Blog on Indian Art
feeds.description: A Blog about Madhubani/Mithila paintings by Vidushini. The blog is all about reviving the Traditional Mithila Folk Art and taking it to a new level.

feeds.title: VarnaChitra
feeds.description: This blog contains paintings depicting landscapes, nature, still life, figurative paintings and creative works in contemporary style. Most of the paintings are acrylic paintings done in realistic oil painting style, either on acid free paper or on canvas. There are also works in watercolor, graphite pencil, charcoal pencil, colored pencil, pastels and crayons.

feeds.title: Artists of India Blog
feeds.description: The Paintings on this blog are by various young and upcoming artists from India. Through this blog, Arti tries to show Indian culture through the medium of paintings.

feeds.title: State of the Art
feeds.description: The Saffronart blog features timely and engaging videos, reports, interviews, behind-the-scenes images and more from our offices around the world. We hope our regular posts on this blog will offer you new insights into the products we feature in our online auctions, new ideas about collecting, and also a new perspective on Saffronart.

feeds.title: India Art Blog
feeds.description: This blog will announce key additions and happenings in the world of Indiaart. This will include new artist additions, new paintings of existing artists, addition of new sculptors as well as their sculptures, tributes and obituaries of artists and personalities related to the world of art with whom Indiaart has had the privilege of being associated with and any other relevant information and news.

feeds.title: Visions Art Blog
feeds.description: Immerse yourself in a world of creativity and inspiration at Visions Art. Explore the stunning and diverse collection of artists that showcase a wide range of artistic visions. Since 2018, Visions Art has leveraged cutting-edge features, advisory services, and marketing support to elevate the presence of artists while facilitating art sales.

feeds.title: Pencil And Chai Fine Arts Gurukul Blog
feeds.description: Pencil And Chai is to Deliver the structured Fine Arts Education in the most beneficial way to the art lovers. Money is not we look for but the craving for art within oneself and thus we offer the least expensive Art Education with highly experienced mentors and quality sessions than any other Art School in India. Read the updates, an article on design principles, art theories curated by our teachers, and more on the blog.

feeds.title: Mesmerart
feeds.description: Hi Everyone! Good day. I have been started painting since my childhood. Its my pleasure to create a blog for sharing my artworks. Hope you will enjoy my blog.

feeds.title: The WordsWay Worth
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Swasthi. Welcome to The WordsWay Worth. I started blogging only since June 2020 and I'm new to the whole Blogging experience. Basically, this blog is just an expression of some of my own thoughts (some are a bit weird!) based on my art & paintings, without any set genre as such. Many people say that every art we create is up to some deeper meaning by itself.

feeds.title: Royal Craft India Blogs
feeds.description: A blog about the traditional arts of India. We bring the story behind the vast array of arts practiced by traditional artisans. The story about the products and what makes them unique and worth collecting.

feeds.title: Indian Art Ideas Blogs
feeds.description: Indianartideas was conceived with the aim of bringing artists and art collectors, most notably the Indian art collectors closer to each other with little or no involvement of traditional art galleries.

feeds.title: Amar Singha Blog
feeds.description: Amar Singha is an award winning contemporary Indian artist. This website is for artists where you can find original painting, print,design and original oil paintings of Amar Singha.
